description: Vendor layout map: which archive in vendor/ unpacks to which directory under build/, and for which toolchain chains. This file and docs/SOURCES.md describe one fact in two notations; scripts/unpack-vendor.ps1 executes this one, scripts/source-parity.ps1 keeps SOURCES.md and fetch-vendor.ps1 honest, and the archive/kind/top fields here are the same rows fetch-vendor.ps1 verifies. vendor/ is gitignored, so this map is part of the only interface between 'public repository' and 'buildable from source'.

notes: dest = scopePaths[scope] + '/' + dir, with {chain} expanded per entry.chains
top is the real top-level directory inside the archive, measured 2026-10-29; it differs from dir for seven entries, so an unpack that does not rename produces a tree no build script can find

movable entries carry top_prefix instead of top: GitHub names the archive top-level directory after the ref it archived (tktreectrl-main/ for the branch form, tktreectrl-<sha>/ for the commit-pinned form), so a fixed top would reject the pinned form with a correct archive inside. fetch-vendor.ps1 leaves t='' on the same rows for the same reason; the marker records the top actually seen
version is what the tree declares about itself (AC_INIT / configure.ac / pkgIndex.tcl), not what the file name says; tktreectrl is the case where the two disagree

provides is what ARRIVES inside the archive, not what the kit builds: tdbcmysql/tdbcpostgres arrive inside the Tcl tarball and are never built (docs/SOURCES.md). This map is about delivery; the build matrix is another layer
derived[] is not unpacked: those paths are created by the build itself and are listed so the map is complete

entries.note: the eight pkgs directories arrive inside this tarball; there is no separate download for them (docs/SOURCES.md)

adopt.notes: one pristine-archive file is regenerated by the build and expected absent from an adopted (previously hand-unpacked) tree; unpack-vendor -Adopt tolerates it

entries.note: taken from the Debian orig tarball, not upstream (docs/SOURCES.md, decision A7)
the GitHub tag is v5.2, so the archive top is twapi-5.2 while every build script path says twapi-5.2.0

adopt.notes: the three upstream prebuilt dyncall *.lib bundles are replaced by our own /MT rebuild during the build (scripts/build-msvc-ext.bat, docs/SOURCES.md); an adopted tree carries the replaced bytes, so compare skips them

entries.note: bundled inside TWAPI too; ours is rebuilt so the kit can link a static-CRT copy (patches/README.md)
the upstream tag is tkdnd-release-test-v2.9.5, which is why the archive top repeats the project name
file name and directory say 2.5.1, the tree declares 2.5.2 (AC_INIT([treectrl],[2.5.2])); the 2.5.1 in paths is a path name, not a component version (docs/SOURCES.md)
the only ext directory without a version suffix; the tree is fossil master after the 1.2 release, with TEA conversion
four files only; no LICENSE inside, the grant is a wiki page (docs/SOURCES.md, decision R1)
taken from the official tcltk/itk GitHub mirror; core.tcl-lang.org throttles

derived.why: nmakehlp -L looks for itcl next to the other ext dirs; itcl has no archive of its own
